text:
Before: salad bowl (tomato, snow peas, cucumber, feta, dressing) about 200 g and 150 kcal. Sushi, 5 pieces, about 150 g and 220 kcal. Two spring rolls, about 200 g and 300 kcal. Soy sauce, ginger and wasabi make up the rest.

After: everything was eaten except some salad dressing, part of the soy sauce, the ginger, and some wasabi.

Eaten: salad about 190 g at 140 kcal, sushi 150 g at 220 kcal, spring rolls 200 g at 300 kcal, ginger 15 g at 5 kcal, soy sauce 10 g at 5 kcal, wasabi 3 g at 5 kcal. Total is roughly 670 kcal and 570 g.
